blocks.raw: Filtered audiences are **not refreshed automatically by default** after ETL sync. They are refreshed automatically only when used in an active journey. In such cases, the audience is updated after each ETL sync.

blocks.raw: ### 2. Under what conditions are filtered audiences not refreshed automatically?
blocks.text: 2. Under what conditions are filtered audiences not refreshed automatically?

blocks.raw: Filtered audiences are not refreshed automatically by default. They remain unrefreshed unless they are used in an active journey.
blocks.text: Filtered audiences are not refreshed automatically by default. They remain unrefreshed unless they are used in an active journey.

blocks.raw: ### 3. When does a manual refresh reflect in campaigns?
blocks.text: 3. When does a manual refresh reflect in campaigns?

blocks.raw: Manual refresh reflects in campaigns based on the campaign type:
blocks.text: Manual refresh reflects in campaigns based on the campaign type:

blocks.raw:
* **One-time campaigns:**\
  The updated audience is used only if the campaign is scheduled **after the manual refresh**.

* **Recurring campaigns:**\
  The audience is refreshed **before each execution**, so the latest data is always used.
blocks.text: One-time campaigns:The updated audience is used only if the campaign is scheduled after the manual refresh.Recurring campaigns:The audience is refreshed before each execution, so the latest data is always used.

blocks.raw: ### 4. When are filtered audiences refreshed in active campaigns using ETL sync?
blocks.text: 4. When are filtered audiences refreshed in active campaigns using ETL sync?

blocks.raw: For **active recurring campaigns**, the associated filtered audience is refreshed **before each execution**, ensuring the latest data is used.
blocks.text: For active recurring campaigns, the associated filtered audience is refreshed before each execution, ensuring the latest data is used.
